title: Axiom consolidated acceptance catalog
purpose: Test specifications and tracking seeds; not executable game tests and not evidence of execution.

cases.category: Repository, execution, and evidence
cases.acceptance: The actual repository, branch, dirty files, executable, seed/save, dependencies, and source ownership are recorded; prior reported status is not substituted for inspection.

cases.category: Repository, execution, and evidence
cases.acceptance: All required owned source and original asset inputs are tracked/reproducible; unrelated work is untouched and no hidden local file is required.

cases.category: Repository, execution, and evidence
cases.scenario: Existing save migration and rollback safety
cases.acceptance: Backups and migrations preserve canonical entities, construction, quantities, and versions; an incompatible migration fails safely without silent regeneration.

cases.category: Repository, execution, and evidence
cases.acceptance: An original authored item retains editable source, scale, pivots, materials, collider/ports and import provenance, and is inspected while used in the native game.

cases.category: Repository, execution, and evidence
cases.acceptance: Implemented, unit-tested, native-observed, playtested and performance-validated are reported separately; failed/unavailable checks and placeholders remain visible.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: Same manifest produces the same canonical results across visit orders and worker schedules; adding cosmetic decoration does not move rivers, settlements or deposits.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: Terrain, gravity, ownership, roads, drainage and saved edits remain continuous at all supported region-face seams and exceptional topology locations.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.scenario: Shared map, terrain and orbit facts
cases.acceptance: All representations use the same body parameters and canonical geography; changing camera scale does not create another mutable world.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: The default fixture contains explained lithology, catchments, outlets, strata, springs and actual volumetric openings; refinement preserves macro boundaries.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: At large system coordinates, frame transforms preserve declared player-scale tolerance, rotation and point velocity without early f32 truncation.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.scenario: Operation identity through retries and compaction
cases.acceptance: Duplicate requests, reconnect, journal compaction and expired receipt detail never repeat a successful cost, reward, transfer or damage event.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: Interrupt before/after activation, persistence and receipt; restore one coherent allowed state and correct Applied-versus-Durable semantics.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: Old mesh, collision, navigation, light or proxy results cannot overwrite newer relevant source projections; unrelated inventory changes do not force full rebuilds.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: A world upgrade preserves installed geography, sites, identities, recorded knowledge and player edits; caches can be rebuilt without rewriting canon.

cases.category: Canonical world, generation, and persistence
cases.acceptance: Saved entry reads a current indexed state plus bounded suffix, not full history or global erosion; genuine collision-ready first interaction is measured.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Capture the actual failing timeline and isolate CPU work, GPU work, memory pressure, waits, pipeline compilation or driver causes before claiming a fix.

evidence.dirty_state: Shared checkout; launch snapshot and source hashes in capture directory, not a clean compiler-input manifest.
evidence.fixture_seed_save: Generated hills, seed 74, isolated save; synthetic cross-chunk edit fixture.
evidence.hardware_settings: i7-13700K, RTX 4090 Vulkan, 1280x720; benchmark presentation disables vsync/auto quality; competing builds observed.
evidence.observed_result: 7930 warmed successful frames; p99 21.0437 ms, maximum 5006.4136 ms. Trace isolates a 4995 ms upload interval and a separate 11921 ms final recorder interval.
evidence.remaining_limits: Freeze gate remains open. Upload subcause and original ordinary-play freeze are not established; this is not a matched performance comparison or exact default-presentation run. Final cleanup/async-recorder changes postdate this capture.

evidence.dirty_state: Shared checkout; see launch tree-status.txt and source-hashes.csv.
evidence.fixture_seed_save: Generated hills seed 74; same isolated synthetic edit fixture, verbose tracing disabled.
evidence.hardware_settings: i7-13700K, RTX 4090 Vulkan, 1280x720; benchmark presentation, competing builds observed.
evidence.observed_result: Final build and native run passed execution. Complete benchmark export: 11714 warmed samples, p99 17.5236 ms, max 2123.2048 ms, 22 frames over 50 ms. Bounded asynchronous CSV writer reported 5398 omitted route rows and no I/O error.
evidence.remaining_limits: Freeze acceptance still fails. Route spans are incomplete; cadence uses the complete separate sample export. No matched improvement, uncontended run, normal minimized-window acceptance or complete root cause established.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Saturate producers and stall GPU completion; descriptors, ready outputs, staging and retirements plateau within declared credits without deadlock.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Cancel before/after encoding, supersede a region repeatedly, and reuse handles; no premature reclaim, leaked staging, dropped completion or double release.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Rapid resize/minimize and simulated device recovery keep authority state intact; transitions are bounded, zero-size surfaces handled, and cleanup makes progress.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.scenario: Native budget pressure and pool backing
cases.acceptance: Lower available budget during replacement; optional admission stops, real backing or reuse is demonstrated, and essential correct geometry remains available.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Traverse edge/corner transitions with caves, fine railings, bridges and destroyed landmarks; no sky leaks, filled tunnels, overlap flicker or restored distant tower.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Delay arbitrary child uploads and empty results; the published frontier keeps complete valid coverage, bounded transitions and no unbounded neighbor-refinement cascade.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Remove a wall, move occluders and turn rapidly at non-power-of-two resolutions; compare with unculled output and detect no false hidden actor or stale cover.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Near/far casters, moving fragments, foliage and interiors use correct depth/bias/material behavior without broad black patches or missing geometry.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.scenario: Art identity at actual camera scales
cases.acceptance: Matched native day/night/motion captures show coherent silhouettes, pixel clusters, distinct materials, grouped plants, quiet spaces and accessible original architecture.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Move at supported speed toward an uncached site and reverse; collision/readiness deadlines, upload age and memory remain bounded without missing ground.

cases.category: Rendering, memory, assets, and streaming
cases.acceptance: Compare solid, hollow, checkerboard, perforated and material-fragmented regions at equal voxel count; measure real output/collision/memory costs and preserve supported geometry.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: On the declared compatibility profile, accepted commands reproduce complete canonical state across machines, worker counts and render rates without routine corrective state traffic.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Restore terrain, solver/cache, controller, RNG, material and attachment state; continued hashes match an uninterrupted run, not merely object poses.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Host and other peers continue; the stalled peer exhausts bounded prediction then recovers or receives an explicit readiness result, without global waiting.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Reorder/drop accepted frames and no-event ranges; confirmed time never passes a gap, axes follow bounded hold policy, and one-shot actions never repeat.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: A predicted hole, selection ray, local motion and crate contacts use the same branch; authority rejection restores coherent dependencies without overwriting others edits.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Two players mine/replace one cell; only one gets original loot and a late request cannot destroy a newly placed unrelated machine at the same coordinate.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Receipt/data arrival orders never flash a wall back, spend provisional loot, duplicate sound, or discard unresolved dependent actions.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Race snapshot publication and suffix pinning with edits/compaction; every committed event remains represented exactly once.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.scenario: Late baseline versus newer live state
cases.acceptance: Old epochs and same-epoch stale candidates cannot regress the installed frontier or overwrite newer geometry.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: First join, repair and content transfer under limited upload do not starve controls/receipts; queued bytes, age and processing cost are bounded.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.scenario: Domain merge, split and mode transition
cases.acceptance: Before physical coupling, install a coherent merged baseline; splitting and fallback preserve contacts, momentum, frames, caches and ownership under tested rules.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Portal interest and domain membership reveal only authorized facts; exact-mode convenience does not expose secret inventories or undiscovered private structures.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Test accepted/rejected break-then-shot, replacement blocks, current new cover, moving doors, exhausted history and duplicate fire; authority selects one damage/cost outcome.

cases.category: Authority, local physics, prediction, and deterministic domains
cases.acceptance: Configured RTT, asymmetry, loss, burst loss, reorder, duplication and relay migration converge within declared limits; report complete traffic, state age, corrections and replay costs.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: Cut a structure and collect fragments; original terrain, debris, salvage and inventory never own the same quantity twice.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: Connected but overloaded construction can fail under the defined model; unknown unloaded support is not automatically detached or a certified anchor.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.scenario: Support deletion with cyclic and cross-brick bonds
cases.acceptance: Repeated cuts and moving attachments yield correct bounded component work, mass/inertia, point velocities, cargo and collider publication.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.scenario: Heated tank, powered hinge and floating crate
cases.acceptance: Breach the tank while inlet and obstacle move; real flow, pressure, heat and two-way impulses operate once within declared numerical tolerances.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: Across active/inactive or adjacent patches, preserve mass/composition/heat/motion as supported; no invisible drain/wall, duplicated flux or camera-dependent disappearance.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: Freeze flowing water around a cable, load/cut it and melt it; latent heat, fluid/solid ownership, tension and collision remain coherent.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.scenario: Grains on belt, settling and reload
cases.acceptance: Transport, settle, save, reopen and excavate material without a body per grain, duplicated quantity or reset provenance.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.scenario: Fast projectile and rotating thin cover
cases.acceptance: Swept contacts use the correct revised geometry for both moving participants; render approximation does not grant tunneling or phantom obstruction.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: Converge existing bodies, alter gravity near sleepers and drive joint loops; common physics stays correct with measured contacts/constraints and no private accuracy reduction.

cases.category: Coupled physical materials and bounded destruction
cases.acceptance: After projectile activation, saturate derived queues; reserved effects and costs occur once at the defined stage/tick rather than disappearing or being indefinitely delayed.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Actual mine/build/hoe/harvest/bucket/shear/fish/ignite/map/repair affordances use correct tags, feedback and authoritative results, not inventory icons only.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Place, rotate, remove and repair supported fine shapes on large cells; collision/selection/quantity and seam behavior agree.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Ghosts show real fit/resources; survival consumes once, creative sources are labeled, undo respects ownership, and construction does not steal neighbouring structures.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Repeated sorting/stacking preserves lot compatibility, quality, identity/quantity and locked/favourite slots across saves and concurrent edits.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Incremental index follows container moves, locks, range/connections and destruction without full-world scans or access to private containers.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: Exactly one valid transaction acquires the final input; duplicate ingredients/overflow/partial capacity are handled without partial unrecorded consumption.

cases.category: Ordinary tools, building and storage
cases.acceptance: A fresh survival fixture provides useful storage, shelter, food/light and simple work without compulsory boss kills, slaughter, AFK or advanced-chip fabrication.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Alternate ore routes change recovery/purity/byproducts while conserving represented feedstock and inputs; reload does not reroll yield.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Closed DC network, resistance/heating, source/provider/port limits and capacitor behavior agree with the declared model; large capacity does not grant unlimited power.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Converters, electrolysis/fuel-cell or equivalent loop, pumps, heat exchange and cooling cannot create free energy through missing losses or erased heat.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Stop power, fill output, change a valve and save mid-stage; quantities and partial state remain coherent with useful player-facing diagnoses.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Two networks wake one consumer, reused entities and canceled events; no duplicate activation/transfer and no unbounded stale scheduler storage.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Coarse/batched advancement matches the defined tick model through thresholds and interruptions; broken logistics and blocked outputs do not produce offline goods.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Two distinct layouts show different real IO/memory/control/throughput behavior with test-bench diagnostics; design save, manufacture and installation preserve function.

cases.category: Scientific industry, electricity and control
cases.acceptance: Prospect or salvage, process, fabricate a controller, power/automate a pump and improve a place; statistics expose actual throughput, losses, quality and bottlenecks.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Deck order/shuffle, triggers, cost, delay and modifier composition behave as declared; recursive expansion is bounded and errors are understandable.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Donor material becomes constrained panels with actual voids/collision, force limits and occupant handling; payload activation follows real supported closure state.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Hammerhand/additional heads and output modifiers perform paid work; debris/store/transmute/XP paths cannot duplicate the same resource.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: An actual organism gains supported behavior, anatomy/collider/mass or explicit magic-source changes and persistent identity, not only a scaled visual.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: A restricted technique uses discoverable dependencies and effective counters; consent and legitimate alternatives matter, not just a purple damage type.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Only allowed observations/anchors influence behavior; reload and networking preserve limits, respite and ownership without omniscient inventory counters.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Supported investigative/resolution path works; wards and uninvolved co-op players remain protected, with no fake chat or offscreen storage deletion.

cases.category: Magic, living transformations and personal threat
cases.acceptance: Original held wand/tool has useful grip, scale, animation, cast origin and coherent world/icon appearance; native use is reviewed rather than inferred from Blender output.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Repeated activation of adjacent districts refines one household/journey/consignment, never duplicates stock or overlaps abstract and physical work.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Different supported body plans can reach home/work/services; organisms follow habitat and ordinary routines without meal-by-meal micromanagement.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Public work, restricted rooms, service routes and actual containment exist; research/trade/service/infiltration have distinct consequences and alarms do not instantly fail the site.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: New construction respects plots, resources, access and player edits; no overnight overwrite or visit-order reroll.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Broadcast/map information has a real source/window/uncertainty and authorized destination; missed windows have supported alternatives rather than permanent ordinary lockout.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Warehouse, carrier, coarse travel, pod, dock and recipient transfer one recorded cargo identity; disconnect/reload cannot award it twice.

cases.category: People, ecology, institutions and real consignments
cases.acceptance: Hospitality, trade, restoration, gardens and specialist work create real benefits; prosperity does not mandate endless escalating raids or city-government chores.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: Stream/embankment/gallery loop offers visible invitation, several approaches, evidence, optional action/understanding, quiet discovery and a meaningful return.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: Digging, building, gliding or another supported bypass discovers a coherent site and valid clues rather than broken scripting or blanket immunity.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: At least one pressure/gravity/false-wall/fold interaction uses real state and multiple solutions with legible consequences, not hidden matching-key flags.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: Observed/reported/inferred/tested records retain source/time; clues and old maps do not become omniscient exact markers or reroll on visit order.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: A view/person/specimen is worthwhile without obligatory loot/combat; optional guidance supports players who cannot rely on subtle sound or color.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: Distinct roles, telegraphs, recovery, paths and actual counterplay work alone and in co-op; damage persists and no instant input-reading defeats clever methods.

cases.category: Exploration, regional composition and systemic dungeons
cases.acceptance: Supported ecosystem/ritual resets have real costs/population/provenance; repaired routes and player changes remain useful without duplicate experience/material.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Universe family, realm, body and frame remain separate; direct requests cannot forge discovery/private permissions or restricted cross-family travel.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Local travel and valid paired return work; ordinary flight or ordinary forged portals cannot connect different Crimson planet pockets.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: An ordinary electrical machine continues functioning while a sustained magical binding attenuates; material fire and unsupported magical structures follow distinct rules.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Position, direction, orientation and handedness map correctly for nonparallel apertures and different gravity frames.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Rotating/translating source and destination preserve intended portal-relative motion, angular state and explicit energy accounting without giant accidental orbital impulses.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.scenario: Native visible doorway and mid-crossing view
cases.acceptance: Parallax, near-plane behavior, occlusion and clipped actors work from oblique angles and halfway through, with no black frame, fake screenshot or source fog contamination.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Pending aperture is visibly blocked; preview sends no private data and traversal waits only for that valid transfer rather than pausing every player.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Simultaneous travelers and retries at the exact transfer tick produce one entity/cargo owner each and a consistent save/reload result.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.acceptance: Recursion/render-target/interest budgets are bounded; closed-while-occupied and unsupported ropes/fluid/networks follow explicit policies rather than deletion or hidden fake continuity.

cases.category: Realm topology and immersive portal correctness
cases.scenario: Remote edits and players through a portal
cases.acceptance: Two clients see actual destination movement and current terrain; source/destination view histories and authoritative interest remain coherent during editing and recovery.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Spacecraft & Space Building contains functional parts/blueprints; Kestrel can be edited and built from the same survival-compatible kit.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Launching/staging/landing never swaps to an unrelated prefab, carries the hangar, duplicates hulls or loses module/cargo ownership.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Thin walls, corners, windows, partial shapes and fine/coarse joints produce correct seal/leak diagnostics; a missing canopy corner cannot be concealed by a seat bubble.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Hatches, breaches, docking and moving volumes conserve gas/enthalpy under the model; unknown topology never certifies safety and closing a door does not refill a room.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Separate pressure/composition, scrubber, power, heat and supplies persist during travel/unload; breach is repairable and a suit enables declared contingency behavior.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Wings require usable airflow/exposure, actuators and finite power; mass/fuel/cargo changes affect steering; vacuum-only craft need no decorative wing blocks.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Installed engines consume finite actual supplies and guidance uses available control authority; insufficient capability is diagnosed rather than corrected by free forces.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.scenario: Altitude versus orbit and round trip
cases.acceptance: A returning arc and stable orbit are distinguished; launch, insertion, rendezvous, deorbit, entry and landing use one consistent configured model without unlabeled cheats.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Clients can walk/drop objects during translation, rotation, acceleration and correction with coherent collision time and no double deck velocity or lost passengers.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: Compatible capture/permissions/seals/equalization precede opening; both vessel identities and all inventory survive repeat docking and restart.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.acceptance: A built station needs supported orbital state; tether/elevator/transfer geometry has explicit eligibility, load/clearance and schedule rather than a generic hovering prop.

cases.category: Voxel spacecraft, pressure, orbit and space building
cases.scenario: First useful orbital return and vehicle portal
cases.acceptance: A real platform mission returns useful cargo to the same workshop; a supported fitting ship can transfer through a legal portal with crew/compartments intact and no Crimson loophole.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Approach/interior/reverse/distant native views establish scale, voids, original structures and useful space; no generic castle or copied finale geometry.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Foundry, vertical machinery/choir and underworks offer distinct routes and systemic choices; damaged paths and player construction remain coherent.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Each completed warden has readable combat and at least one real environmental/engineering intervention tied to functioning machinery, not just a switch counter.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: All valid orders and co-op joins persist correctly; remaining wardens affect the King through declared systems and no client can forge the shared state.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Fair telegraphs, actual hit volumes, dynamic routes, player-built interventions and persistence work without arbitrary immunity or deleting the players tools.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Multiple supported exit/rescue paths preserve participants through disconnect and failure; pre-victory return is available and ordinary possessions are not wiped.

cases.category: Crimson Hall, wardens and enduring progression
cases.acceptance: Successful extraction unlocks only authorized discovered edges; return visits/reset costs/rewards preserve identity, avoid duplicate loot and do not erase the whole location.

cases.category: Whole-game acceptance and release evidence
cases.acceptance: Explorer, factory operator, fighter/builder and joining player share the actual inhabited world under impairment and forced relay with bounded state age and queues.

cases.category: Whole-game acceptance and release evidence
cases.acceptance: Travel, edits, plants, scripts, saves, frames, portals and vehicles stop growing retained state after expected steady demand; post-burst debt drains under continued normal use.

cases.category: Whole-game acceptance and release evidence
cases.acceptance: Lower effects/resolution/detail preserve collision, hazards, clues, cover, material distinction and operable UI; color/sound-only dependencies have alternatives.

cases.category: Whole-game acceptance and release evidence
cases.acceptance: Globe, far skyline, near terrain, interior, vehicle frame, portal view and reload agree on consequential edits and identities through extended play.

cases.category: Whole-game acceptance and release evidence
cases.acceptance: Provide original code/assets, executable native procedures, observed failures, measured comparisons and remaining scope; no synthetic screenshot or unrun test presented as proof.
